# Steering upgrades for larger tires

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Replace the stock center link with an aftermarket unit featuring spherical bearings or through-bolts for rigidity. [t2303]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Identify the center link as a potential weak point due to its stud and ball joint connection.
2. Replace the stock center link with an aftermarket unit featuring spherical bearings or through-bolts for rigidity.

_Procedure reported by [t2303]._

## Parts

- Aftermarket Center Link: Features spherical bearing and through-bolt connection [t2303]
- [Partial] Bronze Idler Arm Bushings: For upgraded durability over stock rubber [t2303]
- HD Tie Rod Adjusters: Replaces threaded rod to prevent breaking [t2303]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that a custom center link may require drilling out the idler and pitman arm attachment points to accept larger diameter bolts. [t2303]
